component.name: Tether
component.summary: ADHD Flowmodoro and impulse-parking companion for developers

description.p: Tether is an unbreakable Flowmodoro and impulse-parking companion designed specifically for developers with ADHD. It calculates proportional breaks based on your actual focus time, parks sudden rabbit-hole thoughts into RAM-dumps or Side-Quests without breaking your flow, and seamlessly synchronizes with Neovim and VS Code.
Added pause banking on early break termination, per-editor minimize settings, and auto-maximize on break.
Initial release of Tether desktop companion.
